pure_water.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle[/gold] to your hand and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Mantra[/gold].
holy_water.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Miracles[/gold] to your hand and gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Mantra[/gold].
